findings: ContentID is contentLink.Cid.String(); native metadata meta.Hash must equal that exact content CID before capture.
NativeChecksum is meta.Checksum; SourceChecksum is meta.Source. The head constructor copies those exact fields into fileVariantChecksums and fileSourceChecksum.
PlaintextSHA256 independently hashes all decrypted bytes. NativeChecksum uses base32 SHA256 with an appended mode byte; it is not the same representation as plaintext hex SHA256.

UploadChecksumMatches means original path plus verified native checksum plus nonempty SourceChecksum equal NativeChecksum. A false value alone does not negate a complete plaintext capture; it remains preserved metadata and cannot be used as a guessed equality to plaintext SHA.
Only /0/ and the exact OriginalImagePath are classified original; the finite generic-file closure will require /0/ in addition to its FileObject/layout/self-block proof.

Capture walks all local DAG branches, validates content/metadata CIDs, decrypts using exactly the captured FileInfo keys, verifies size and declared checksum, rejects unused keys and requires exactly one original.
